Requested language: en
Reference DATA:
[deposit-us] The U.S. FDIC standard limit is $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per ownership category. Accounts in the same category at one bank are aggregated; simply opening more accounts does not multiply coverage. Eligible deposits may be insured, while investments such as stocks, bonds and mutual funds are not FDIC-insured deposits. These U.S. rules do not apply to mainland China, Hong Kong or other jurisdictions. Verify bank and account eligibility. Reviewed snapshot: 2026-11-10.
